messages.text: Are you still covering the 10:30 section today?
Yeah. Swapped the wrinkled shirt before leaving and packed the slides in my bag.
Good. Morales is observing two rooms this morning, so bring the indoor voice and the clean cuffs.
Already on campus. Coffee first, office hour sign second.
Your aunt asked if you still have that ballot guide you marked up. She wants to know who you liked for school board and city council.
Yes. I circled the candidates backed by the teachers, clinic coalition, tenants group, and the arts fund folks.
I figured. She keeps getting those red glossy mailers and asked me if they were real information.
Tell her I tossed those. I will bring my notes Sunday and we can compare before she fills anything out.
You still going up to Oakland Saturday or waiting on that school check?
Waiting. The February form is still sitting in somebody's queue, so I'm not buying another ticket for a maybe-useful panel.
Good. Don't front money for them twice.
Exactly. I'll stay local and read the Article 12 notes Alina sent before Friday's campus meeting.
Baby, I found that little notebook with the South Carolina names tucked behind my church programs.
Baby, Sunday bring that little recorder if you still got it. I remembered what my daddy said about the train out of Baton Rouge.
I have it charged. Do you want me to ask about Aunt Pearl too or just let you talk?
Please keep it safe. Those names might help me line up the questions before I price the Accra flight again.
Ask about Pearl and them boys in Charleston. And don't let your mama rush me when the greens come out.
You always did want the story behind the story. Don't spend that envelope unless it's for the plane.
I will protect the tape and the greens schedule.
I won't. I added another $60 after tutoring, so the separate total is holding at $1,200.
You still awake with those papers?
You disappeared after that chair email. Eat anything yet?
Yeah. I made the three-column list like you said: must grade tonight, can wait, email tomorrow.
Half a bagel. I typed a whole IG caption and deleted it.
Good. Eat something, shower, then stop after the must-grade pile. No heroic 1am spiral.
Good. Fork, water, shower. Then tell me the exact part that actually needs an answer tonight.
Deal. Also moved the Friday Dr. K hold earlier so it does not sit right after seminar.
Calling you in 5. I need the version where you just let me say it first.
Baby, if you use those greens tonight, put your smoked turkey in first and let it take its time.
I did. Rice is going too, and I found the last bag of beans behind the lentils.
Good. Don't let all those little jars on your counter go stale after you paid for them.
That's the part that got me. Replacing the empty ones cost almost as much as the vegetables.
Baby, I found that old photo from the Long Beach house, the one with you in your Wilson hoodie and Maya standing on the porch steps.
The blue house on 10th? If Mom sees that picture she is going to point out the crooked blinds before anything else.
Your daddy was probably already gone before sunup for the docks that morning. Your mama had all those school office papers stacked on the kitchen table.
That sounds exactly like that year. Send it to me before Sunday so I can scan it at their place.
Baby, did you get something warm in you after class?
Yes ma'am. Rice, lentils, canned tomatoes, and the last greens. I made enough for tomorrow too.
Good. And don't let that sore tooth make you stubborn.
I called Dr. Kim's office. I put the new date in my March sheet after checking what cleared today.
Did you leave campus yet or are you still doing that one-more-email thing?
Almost out. I'm taking the Studebaker side home and doing one lap by the pond first.
Good. Ten minutes outside before opening the laptop again.
That's the plan. If I cut across Spring, I can still be back before the rice cooker finishes.
You up or did the alarm lose again?
Up. Shoes are by the door, bottles filled. Rolling out in a few.
Good. Text me after the Thursday crew stops pretending Ocean Blvd is peaceful.
Door locked. Back before office hours if nobody decides to sprint.
You still at Wilson or did the teenagers drain your whole battery?
Leaving now. One junior finally got slope-intercept to click, so I am counting that as a win.
Good. Eat before you start grading your actual pile.
I will. Ms. Reed also asked if I can bring extra FAFSA examples next time because two seniors are stuck on parent sections.
Are you still holding that 9-10 Friday slot, or did the department inbox eat it?
Holding it. Mail app is staying shut until the timer ends.
Good. Put the grant date somewhere you will actually look at it.
Already copied it onto the March page beside the lecture prep list.
Your grandmother asked if she should wait for the church flyer or call her clinic. I told her you would look at the real pages.
Clinic first. I checked Dr. Nguyen's message, then the county update. The flyer left out the timing piece.
Good. Send me the county link and I will print it for her appointment folder.
Sending that plus the campus health note. They say the same thing in plainer language.
Can you send me the student-facing version? Mine still has the instructor note in the margin.
Yep, putting the clean copy in the shared Doc now. I left the source list in the side comments.
Thanks. Also your green discussion slides saved me from rebuilding that whole section.
Keep the green ones, but skip the red transition slide unless your room setup can handle breakout timing.
You coming by Sunday before the Lakers game or after?
After. I have Lena's Thursday plan to repeat this morning, then the small home set so I don't limp up Mom's porch steps.
Keep it smart. No need showing off with bad stairs waiting at the house.
I'm keeping the jumps out. Just rows, hinges, carries, and the slow step thing on the low box.
You heading downtown today or staying near campus?
Downtown for a bit. Keeping it early, backpack light, ID in the outside pocket.
Good. Window down, palms where they can see them if anybody waves you over. No quick reaching.
I know. Same script as last time: calm voice, say what I'm doing before I move.
Baby, I found the old program from New Hope on Atlantic. The one with your great-aunt's name spelled wrong.
Please save it for me. That spelling mistake belongs in the chapter with the porch recording.
You and those notebooks. Just make sure you tell it right and eat before you start typing.
I will. Also, I may ask you for permission to use two minutes from Sunday's story when I send the sample pages.
Am I still okay to crash at your place after family dinner tomorrow?
Yeah. Same couch, same spare key spot, same annoying gate code.
That gate code has survived since your box-mountain weekend. Historic.
Historic and apparently worth the $1,850 hit that posted this week.
I found the county booklet on the kitchen counter. Do you want me to save it for you or recycle it?
Save it, please. I want to compare the city clerk section with the online statements before I seal mine.
Of course. Your father already circled the utility board names and then walked away from the whole stack.
Tell him I am taking the stack after dinner. Tiny print and all.
You already back? Wind was pushing hard by the water when I left the port.
Back. Started before traffic got messy and stayed on the separated lane most of the way.
Good. Charge that rear light before you forget.
Plugged in next to the pump. I made coffee and feel less wound up than yesterday.
You still coming by later? Lakers tip is 6:30.
Yes. I am leaving the cafe now. Marcus took the first two games and I only salvaged the last one.
Good. Eat something real before you get here, not just coffee.
I did. Eggs, toast, and one mimosa. I am switching to water for the drive and the rest of the day.
Baby, bring that little recorder if you come after church. I remembered the part about your great-aunt leaving South Carolina with two hat boxes.
I will. I have campus prep tonight, but I can come by 3:30 and keep it short.
Short is fine. And don't let me forget the blue folder from the clinic table.
Got it. I'll bring the release page too, only if your hand feels steady enough.
Baby, did you see the pictures your cousin put up from choir rehearsal?
Not yet. I'll check FB after lunch. I mostly go there for family and church things anyway.
Tell her the blue dress looked nice. She asked if you were still showing those mural pictures somewhere.
Those are on IG. I'll send you the link, but don't worry about making an account for it.
Baby, when you come Sunday, bring that little recorder. I remembered the Lake Charles part with Aunt Ruth.
I can come after 2. I'll ask before I turn it on, same as last time.
And don't clean up my wording. If I say 'we made a way,' leave it like that.
I will. Phone off, TV down, your words first.
Baby, I found that cassette where Aunt Ruth talks about leaving Shreveport. The little machine still plays it if you hold the button down.
Please keep it on the kitchen table. I want to transcribe a short part for Tuesday's class activity, only if you're still okay with it.
You can use it. Just don't let those children miss how she pauses before she says the train station.
That's exactly the moment I want them to notice before they start their paragraph revisions.
Mom made too much arroz con pollo. Want me to drop a container by your place after class?
Yes please. The small fridge is looking dramatic and I have papers stacked across the little dining table.
Do I need to pack extra portions or is this a Joshua-only rescue mission?
Joshua-only. Also if the rent reminder magnet is still on the door, ignore it. Paid Friday.
You disappeared after that stack of papers. Did you eat actual food or just coffee?
Ate. Also opened the black dotted book and put the day down in tiny broken lines instead of touching the papers again.
Good. Keep that page away from the red pen pile.
That is the point. No comments in the margin, no score, just me and the page.
Are you still going to that tiny room after office hours or did grading win?
Going. Their post said doors at 7 and only 35 chairs, so I am leaving campus fast.
Bring the blue notebook. You always pretend you will remember the good lines.
Already packed. Also saved the bookstore flyer in case the late list opens.
Are you still stopping by that little shop after campus, or did the meeting eat the whole evening?
Still going. I saved a 6:20 block for the shelf reading and the alley light behind it.
Good. Keep the block. Also please do not rewrite tomorrow's handout from scratch at 11 pm.
Deal. Two edits, dinner, then I can sort the best square crop before bed.
Did you finish the rent transfer before dinner?
Yes. I built it around the $3,650 that cleared Friday, so rent and the car payment are covered.
Good. Also, please don't keep adding late nights just because the campus portal is open.
I know. Last week already landed at 46 and change, and tonight is just lecture notes.
That tire light still on? Don’t ride around on it all week.
Taking it to the shop before campus tomorrow. If it’s around $400 I can pull from the Ally pocket and leave the card alone.
Good. Get the price in writing before they start adding extras.
Yep. I already moved this week’s food numbers around so it doesn’t mess up rent.
Baby, Ms. Claudette said she still remembers you on that front riser with the blue tie, loud enough for the back pew.
She has a long memory. I was mostly following whatever you and Mom were doing.
You sent me that Gregory Porter track too. That man knows how to let a line breathe.
That's why I like him. Feels close to those Sunday mornings without copying them.
Saw the contract note. Please tell me you are not processing that in a comments section.
No. I sent M the screenshot and closed the app.
Excellent. Let her do the quiet nodding thing first. Department analysis can wait until coffee.
She already asked whether I ate, so the system is operating normally.
You heading to the Y after office hours or coming straight home?
Depends how fast I finish these last comments. They said they might need one more for 5s.
Stretch first. Last time you walked in cold and complained all Sunday.
I know. Shoes are in the trunk this time.
Baby, I found that little hospital bracelet in the blue envelope. It has 3/12/00 printed so tiny I had to get my glasses.
Please keep it out of the sauce zone tomorrow. Maya already threatened to put it on the table next to the cake.
I put it with the photo of your mama holding you before we brought everybody back down Atlantic.
That whole envelope is dangerous. Half the room will start telling stories before dinner even lands.
Department agenda just landed. It is somehow both 2 pages and endless.
I blocked 10:00-10:25 to outline only the two items that affect us. Not touching email before then.
Good. Also, I can take the first five minutes of workshop if your Dr. K thing shifts again.
Thank you. I am trying to keep that slot this month instead of punting it like February.
Did you see campus health updated the spring clinic note again? Half the department thread is just screenshots from random accounts.
Yeah, I am using the campus note and the CDC table, not the screenshot parade.
That tracks. Are you still doing the Friday slot after class?
Only if Dr. Nguyen's office confirms the timing. I left a portal message this morning.
Dept admin just sent the revised fall grid. Did your two sections stay on it?
One did. The other has the little asterisk of doom next to enrollment review.
Save that email. The rep said the timeline language matters when they reshuffle this late.
Can you send me the college-essay checklist you made for those Wilson seniors? I want to borrow the format for my office hours.
Yes, after class. It has the 'what if nobody at home has done this form before' page too.
Already filed it with the Article 12 notes. Also pausing the San Jose workshop train until the March deposit clears.
That page is the useful one. Also the department meeting moved to 3:30, so your after-school Thursday is untouched.
Perfect. I promised Ms. Reed every other Thursday this month and I do not want to scramble.
Did your 11am group handle the Baldwin passage better after you made them map who gets to speak in each paragraph?
Much better. Their first drafts were all summary, so I had them mark claims in blue and evidence in yellow.
Stealing that for my Wednesday section. Also, your Jacobs handout survived the copier tray war.
Good. I need it for the 2pm group before conferences start.
Did you protect Friday morning, or did the grading pile eat it?
Protected. I need two clean hours for the Fulbright-ish draft and the recording plan.
Good. Put the Cape Coast names in an appendix, not the main narrative. Cleaner for committee eyes.
That helps. If the budget stays honest, the $1,200 can cover the first deposit instead of disappearing into random bills.
The campus statement is out. Lots of verbs, zero line items.
Exactly. I can work with an actual allocation, a public deadline, and one person whose name is on the follow-through.
I figured you would ask for the spreadsheet before the applause.
Applause is cheap. Also sent $8 to the mutual-aid link from last week's downtown thread.
One of my 210 students found me on IG again. I left it sitting there. You?
Same. If they're in my class this term, I keep it to campus email or Canvas until grades are done.
Clean. Also, are you still checking X for conference chatter?
Barely. I saved one CFP thread and got out. LinkedIn had the useful department post anyway.
Happy day, son. I still remember Darryl trying to beat morning traffic from the westside and calling everybody from the hospital pay phone.
Thank you, Ma. Please do not let Dad retell the parking story for the 200th time tonight.
No promises. Dinner is 6:30, and Maya said she is bringing the candles shaped like 2 and 6.
That is exactly the kind of sibling behavior I expected.
Your grandma found that biscuit tin with the folded papers. She said one has the Beaufort cousin's number written on the back.
Can you put it somewhere safe? I'll scan whatever she lets me scan after dinner.
Already in the blue folder. Also, she corrected me twice about which aunt sang lead at Mt. Zion, so be ready.
Noted. I'll bring the scanner and stay out of the choir debate unless invited.
If you stop by after class, can you bring the extra ice packs from the freezer?
Yes. I am going straight from the 6:30 block, so I will grab them after I do the couch-band routine.
Do the whole routine, not half because you are rushing.
I know. The coach already swapped loaded lunges for the wall hold and slow lowers tonight.
That campus packet you mentioned, does it come with benefits or is it another semester-to-semester thing?
This one would be different. I need the writing sample, teaching file, and the neighborhood project budget clean by the 20th.
Good. Put the numbers where people can see them. Same way we do at the port.
I hear you. I am also adding the student workshop piece so it does not look like the project lives only on paper.
You coming by Sunday before tipoff or after?
Before. I can help Mom move the folding table first.
Good. Bring that HDMI cord too. The stream froze twice last time.
Got it. I'll grab it from my desk before I leave.
Port guys were arguing over that council race again. One flyer says the warehouse safety rules will kill jobs.
That is the same mailer pretending bathroom breaks and heat rules are some wild idea. I am sticking with the labor council pick.
You always read the fine print, professor.
Only because the red side keeps making working people sound like a budget problem.
Baby, did you write down my Tuesday ride, or do I need to remind your mama too?
I put it on the little grid under family, with the pharmacy stop right after.
You and those tiny boxes. Long as I get there on time.
You will. I also moved one school task off Tuesday so it does not crowd the ride.
You vanished fast after the meeting. Everything okay?
Yeah. I needed air before office hours. Did the little El Dorado detour and I'm heading back toward campus now.
That route is unfairly convenient for you.
It's the only reason I can reset between a department meeting and student emails without losing the whole afternoon.
Can we move coffee to noon tomorrow? I forgot your Saturday dawn thing eats the first part of the day.
Noon works. I should be back, rinsed off, and less useless by then.
Same Junipero group?
Yeah, the LBCC folks posted the route last night.
I saw you close that little notebook before the meeting. Please tell me that was not another prep list.
Only half a prep list. The rest was a few spare lines about the copier light blinking like it had a secret.
Did you survive the 9 a.m. room with the broken projector, or did the students stage a quiet revolt?
They were kind. I had them annotate on paper like it was 2006. Also finished the thesis-signature scan for HR before class.
That is a better use of the copier than anything the department has done this week.
Good. Protect Friday writing time, please. Your archive proposal won't write itself between grade appeals.
It stayed between the attendance notes and the Trader Joe's list. Very official filing system.
Trying. Ann Arbor emailed again about the April visit, but I can't disappear with Lillian's Tuesday ride and these sections.
Are you bringing something Sunday or just coming straight after church?
I can bring the pot with shrimp and tomatoes, but I may need to stop in Signal Hill first.
Don't run all over town for one meal. Everything out here is high right now.
I know. The cheaper bag looked sad, and the decent one made the receipt jump.
Did you print that resident ledger before the portal times out? I need the March line for my folder.
Doing it after class. It shows the same $1,850 as February.
Good. Keep the renewal page with the first walk-through pictures, not loose in your backpack.
Yes ma'am. The old blue folder is still in the kitchen drawer.
When you come by Sunday, remind me to give you that old LBCC folder. It has the forklift card and the harbor maps mixed in.
Got it. Mom also wants me to take the frame down from the hallway so she can dust behind it.
The Cerritos one? She'll notice if you put it back crooked. Ask Maya to help, she's shorter but steadier on that little step stool.
I'll make Maya spot me and avoid getting a lecture from both of you.
You still need that quiet room Sunday or are you done with your school calls?
I might use the back room for 40 minutes. Need to test the Zoom link before Monday and make sure the Canvas page opens on my old laptop.
Bring the charger. That laptop quits when you ask it to do two things.
Already packed. The deck is lightweight this time, mostly blue quote cards and a short poll.
Baby, when you come Sunday, bring that little recorder if you want the story about Cousin Ruth.
I will. I am leaving from my place after I run the laundry downstairs.
You keep enough quarters? Those buildings eat money.
Barely. Between laundry, rent, and Edison, March is already trying me.
Lunch check. Please do not answer with coffee.
Not coffee. I brought rice, beans, canned tomatoes, and frozen shrimp from the back of the freezer.
Respectable. Did you move the mouth appointment or just keep staring at the number?
Moved it to after the 27th. My bank app and the sheet finally agree, so I know what that week can handle.
If you see Nina from the cycling group at Portfolio today, ask whether she still has the zine table link.
Will do. I am meeting Marcus there first, then I can ask her if she rolls through after her ride.
Perfect. Also, if they have the pear cider again, do not let me order two when I get there.
Noted. I am sticking to coffee until food shows up anyway.
Port board thing in that packet looks like a mess. You understand any of it?
A little. I am reading the two statements side by side, then checking who endorsed which funding plan.
Send me the short version before Sunday. I am not reading four pages of promises.
I will bring notes. No free passes for the boring boxes.
Baby, did you go hear those people downtown last night?
I did. Six rows, no stage lights really, just a lamp and the upright by the wall.
That sounds like somebody's front room. Did they pass the hat?
Yes, and the shop owner posted the next one for the 27th. I saved it.
Did you eat or just disappear toward the pier again?
Toast before, banana after. I did the short stretch to Shoreline Village and back.
Fine, responsible-ish. Also move the sweaty gloves before I sleep on your couch tonight.
Already airing on the rack, not the couch. You are safe.
Did the tire place try to rob you or was it normal annoying?
$386 after tax. Paid from the side account, then I set the April 3 transfer to refill that chunk.
Very you. Please also buy lunch like a person.
Lunch is in the spreadsheet already. I’m not doing the sad crackers thing today.
Dinner tomorrow. Mom asked if you're coming straight from campus or from a ride.
From campus. I can toss the jacket in the trunk and not show up with chalk dust everywhere.
Please do. Last Sunday you looked like you fought the whiteboard and lost.
Fair. I’ll bring the blue shirt Mom likes so nobody starts.
Are you coming by after the 10:30 today or saving your visit for the 29th?
Today is grading jail. I'm aiming for the 29th and dinner after.
Okay. Pastor Reed's wife asked whether you still know the anniversary refrain. I told her your voice didn't disappear.
I can stand in for one verse, but I'm not getting trapped up front all morning.
Are you coming by after church? I made greens and rice; Lillian wants you to hear the South Carolina piece before she forgets the names.
Yes. I packed the scanner and consent sheet. Nothing goes anywhere until she hears it back.
Good. Your dad can mute the game for twenty minutes.
Tell him I only need the table and the room calm while she talks.
I put your mail on the piano. Are you still getting here around 4?
Yes. I'll pick up ice on the way and stay through the second half.
Your father already claimed the big chair, so do not start with him.
Tell him I am bringing the good snacks as a peace offering.
You get that passport form handled? They ask too many address questions now.
Handled Friday. I listed Long Beach addresses and the clerk said the trip stamps were enough for the rest.
Good. Come by after 4 if you want the leftover cake. Your sister left the number candles on my counter.
I'll swing through after grading. Please hide the parking-lot story before I get there.
You looked tired Sunday. That school check still coming at the end of the month?
Yeah, same date as usual. The worksheet says $4,700 before they peel everything off.
Then pace yourself. One place taking that many evenings is enough.
Trying. I blocked Thursday night so this week doesn't climb past 48 again.
Morning check: did the budget thing get resolved or are you still doing the tight-jaw typing?
Still typing. Almost put a vague Threads thing up at midnight and then heard your voice saying absolutely not.
Correct voice. Send me the two sentences you want to send them, not the whole storm.
Sending now. Also yes, coffee and banana before you ask.
I read the sample pages. The Butler paragraph finally talks to the Lillian transcript instead of sitting next to it.
That was the problem. I need the classroom piece to feel connected too, especially the first-gen students' mapping exercise.
Then keep the map. Cut the committee throat-clearing. Also your three-year table needs one plain-language sentence.
Done after office hours. I want the pages, teaching file, and partner notes telling the same story by Friday.
Your office playlist just went from Coltrane to Gregory Porter to handclaps. Is that your grading survival mode?
Pretty much. Porter keeps it warm without making me stop reading papers.
Also, I saw Sunday morning blocked again on your calendar. I won't put the workshop prep there.
Thanks. Family pew politics are more delicate than department politics.
Your grandmother said you asked her to mark which cousins still remember the Louisiana side. Are you bringing the recorder Sunday?
Yes. I also want her to listen to the intro before I send the campus version.
Fine, but eat before you start working her like a witness. And don't move money from that account for car stuff.
I know. That account is only for airfare, forms, and the first week there.
Your aunt said she tagged you in something from the church fish fry. You see it?
I'll look on FB after I finish these quizzes. I saw the mural walk posts on IG first.
And some kid from your class asked me if you answer DMs. I told him I don't know your business.
Good answer. If he's enrolled now, he can send it through Canvas.
Baby, your mama said you were still marking papers after dinner.
Only one stack left. I took a ride by the river first and made tea before opening the laptop.
That sounds better. Call me Sunday and I will tell you the South Carolina story I forgot last time.
I will. Keeping Sunday quiet after the Dr. K follow-up note and the grant checklist.
Are you still driving to Fresno after your morning class? I can pack you leftovers if you're stopping by.
I'm skipping it. The receipt from February still hasn't come back, and the campus rep office hour is the same afternoon anyway.
That sounds sensible. Keep your folder together before you talk to them.
I have the appointment letter, paystub, mileage form, and the email about possible section changes.
Ms. Reed emailed me by mistake again. She said thank you for staying late with the two boys yesterday.
Ha, same last name problem. Tell her no worries. They needed quiet space to finish the scholarship draft.
I forwarded it. And please keep those Thursdays on your calendar if you are going to commit to them.
Already blocked through April. Just two afternoons a month, so it is manageable if I protect the time.
Your grandma said don't come Sunday asking half questions. She wants you to write the names straight this time.
I learned my lesson after spelling Thibodeaux wrong. I have index cards now.
Good. And ask her about that rice dish from the Carolina side before your mother changes the subject to appointments.
Cards, pen, food questions, and appointment patience. Got it.
Are you still going to the community budget thing after class or did grading eat you alive?
Going. They are taking comments on youth arts grants, tenant legal aid, clinic hours, and the police oversight line.
Send me the sign-up link. I can write something after practicum.
Sending. I am using the same talking points from the slate packet, just shorter.
If you're coming Sunday, can you bring the blue folder from your place?
Yes. I'll grab it after my park walk. I'm starting near Wardlow, then coming back down Bellflower.
Don't overpack your morning. You still need time before you go near campus for those papers.
I know. It's all close enough if I don't wander into the nature center trail.
Baby, did you write down what I told you about your great-uncle and that red porch in Louisiana?
Yes ma'am. It's on the Sunday spread, right under your appointment time and above the market list.
You always put plain things beside pretty things. Don't let anybody fix that page too much.
I won't. That page is just for keeping, not for handing over.
Are you riding over after church or driving?
Driving. I have papers in the back seat and the shoes I wore for the commute are still by the door.
Bring a sweater if you stay for the game. Your grandmother keeps the living room cold.
Got it. Sweater, papers, and the charger.
You see that story from downtown? Reminded me of what my dad said about keeping your hands visible on Artesia.
Yeah. I wrote a few lines, but I'm not making it neat just to make folks comfortable.
Good. Tell it straight or leave it alone. You still coming for the Lakers?
Coming. I'll sit with Lillian first, then game on low.
Baby, your mama said you were coming after church. Bring that little camera if you want the porch before the sun gets too high.
I packed it already. I have groceries at 11:30, lunch at 12:15, and ten minutes for the porch before everybody sits down.
Ten minutes is enough if you look right. The jasmine pot and that old chair tell on us.
I'll get the chair, then the recipe notes while you talk. I might use one line under the picture later.
Your mama said you are bringing the peach tea today.
Yes ma'am. Tea, batteries for the remote, and the box from my trunk.
Your daddy better not yell at that umpire while I am eating.
No promises, but I'll sit near him and lower the volume if needed.
Mom found the rent envelope from the 10th Street place and immediately started sorting it by year because of course she did.
Please tell her not to throw away my Wilson ID. I need the one from the year I turned 16 for the scan pile.
It's safe. Also Dad's harbor badge is in the same bin, which makes no filing sense but feels very us.
That bin is basically our whole old kitchen counter in object form.
You coming Sunday? Your mother said bring nothing if you already got food at home.
I'll come. I still have rice, beans, and greens, so I'm fine till then.
Good. Handle the tooth thing too. Don't wait until it turns into a whole production.
I have April 9 held. Once the bank app clears Friday, I'll mark the Dr. Kim line paid in the sheet.
Did you finish the campus HR form? The one that wanted every place you stayed longer than six months since 18?
Yeah. It was basically Long Beach, then the apartment near campus. The travel boxes stayed empty.
Classic. Also Mom wants your new emergency contact sheet because her oldest child keeps pretending paperwork does itself.
Tell her I'll send it before midnight. Oldest child is tired but compliant.
I moved Lillian's refill pickup to Saturday morning. Can you still handle it before your library recording block?
Yes. I teach until 12:20 Friday, then I'll prep the consent pages and go Saturday before lunch.
And the envelope from Rhode Island?
Are you eating before your early mornings this week or just running on coffee again?
I packed bananas and bars for tomorrow and Saturday. Tuesday was the only rushed one.
Good. And put your reflective vest where you can see it at 6:15, please.
Already on the chair by the door.
Still unopened on my desk. I'm keeping April focused on students, Lillian's appointments, and getting the first interviews transcribed.
Your grandmother said you borrowed the church anniversary booklet again. Bring it back Sunday if your students are done with it.
I just need two pages for tomorrow. They're comparing the booklet with the poem packet before writing their final response.
Make sure her name is on anything you copy. She notices those details.
Already noted. I put her initials beside the photo caption and the date.
Your aunt sent another video to the family chat. Is that the one you said was wrong?
